card.summary: Карманная бензиновая зажигалка с полуавтоматическим откидным рычагом, рекламная, сигарет Kent (Lorillard). На одной стороне вставка с логотипом-замком и надписью «KENT CIGARETTES», на другой лозунг «EXCLUSIVE MICRONITE FILTER» с зелёным росчерком, фон белый в полоску. Такие зажигалки в 1950–60-е годы массово выпускали японские фабрики (Continental/CMC, Penguin, Omega и др.) под заказ табачных брендов. Распространённый недорогой предмет табачной атрибутики, интересен коллекционерам зажигалок и рекламы.

listing_en.title: Vintage Kent Cigarettes Advertising Lighter Micronite Filter 1950s-60s Lift Arm

Vintage advertising pocket lighter for KENT Cigarettes (Lorillard), probably made in Japan, c. 1955-1970. Lift-arm (semi-automatic) petrol/fluid lighter with gold-tone case. One side shows the castle logo and KENT CIGARETTES, the other side the slogan EXCLUSIVE MICRONITE FILTER with a green swirl, both on a white striped panel.

Condition: good vintage condition. Panels are clean and bright, with no visible chips or cracks. Normal wear to the gold-tone finish on the edges and lever. Not tested: sold as a collectible, function not guaranteed. Shipped empty, with no fuel.

Approx. size: 5.5 x 4.5 x 1.2 cm (please see final measurements). Maker's mark on base: see photos.

Great for collectors of tobacciana, vintage lighters and mid-century advertising.

listing_en.title: Vintage Spanish School Oil Painting Village Canal Boat Palette Knife Framed
listing_en.description:
Vintage decorative oil painting, Spanish school, probably 1960s–1980s. A village of whitewashed cottages with a haystack and laundry drying, a calm canal with a moored boat, under a grey evening sky. The paint is thickly applied with a palette knife and brush (impasto). The motif is close to the traditional barracas of the Albufera, Valencia.

Artist unknown; no legible signature visible (please see photos). Housed in a gilt wooden frame.

Approx. size: image 50 x 100 cm, framed approx. 62 x 115 cm (please check exact measurements in photos/description).

Condition: used, consistent with age. A whitish spot or abrasion in the upper left sky near the moon. Paint surface otherwise intact, varnish slightly dull. The frame has wear and small losses to the gilding, mainly on corners and lower edge. Back not inspected in detail, see photos.

A decorative interior piece, sold as is. Carefully packed with corner protectors and cardboard; combined shipping available.

card.shipping: Объёмная, но не очень тяжёлая вещь: в раме на глаз около 62×115 см, 3–5 кг. Защитить углы рамы уголками, лицевую сторону закрыть плёнкой или бумагой без контакта с красочным слоем (на пастозных мазках не должно быть давления), переложить картоном или пенокартоном, упаковать в жёсткую коробку для картин. Международная пересылка за 40–80 € и больше сопоставима с ценой вещи, поэтому лучше продавать внутри страны или с самовывозом.

listing_en.title: Vintage Spanish School Oil Painting Village Canal Boat Palette Knife Framed
listing_en.description:
Vintage decorative oil painting, Spanish school, probably 1960s–1980s. A village of whitewashed cottages with a haystack and laundry drying, a calm canal with a moored boat, under a grey evening sky. The paint is thickly applied with a palette knife and brush (impasto). The motif is close to the traditional barracas of the Albufera, Valencia.

Artist unknown; no legible signature visible (please see photos). Housed in a gilt wooden frame.

Approx. size: image 50 x 100 cm, framed approx. 62 x 115 cm (please check exact measurements in photos/description).

Condition: used, consistent with age. A whitish spot or abrasion in the upper left sky near the moon. Paint surface otherwise intact, varnish slightly dull. The frame has wear and small losses to the gilding, mainly on corners and lower edge. Back not inspected in detail, see photos.

A decorative interior piece, sold as is. Carefully packed with corner protectors and cardboard; combined shipping available.

card.shipping: Bulky but not very heavy: framed approx. 62×115 cm by eye, 3–5 kg. Protect the frame corners with corner guards, cover the front with film or paper without contact with the paint layer (no pressure on the impasto), interleave with cardboard or foam board, and pack in a rigid picture box. International shipping at €40–80 or more is comparable to the item's value, so it is better to sell domestically or for local pickup.

listing_en.title: Michael Cartwright Original Oil Painting Australian Cottage Denmark WA 2000 Framed
listing_en.description:
Original oil painting by Western Australian landscape artist Michael Cartwright (b. 1955), of Denmark, WA. An old timber cottage with a corrugated iron roof stands among bush and tall eucalypts under a soft pastel sky. The paint is thickly textured and applied mostly with a palette knife, typical of the artist.

Signed and dated lower right 'M Cartwright 2000', with the signature scratched into the wet paint. On the reverse is the original label of The Michael Cartwright Gallery, McNabb Road, Denmark ('Paintings of Denmark's Beautiful Scenery'). The label is torn, with part of the right side missing.
